frontText: Navy 55 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: 2-It's wearing off
items.placementTarget: Each Epidemic card, over printed step 2 "Infect."
items.text:
2-It's wearing off
Draw a random Infection card
from Package 6. Remove all the
Supply cubes (if any) in that city.
Then, discard that card.

effect: Draw a random Infection card from Package 6.
Remove all the Supply cubes (if any) in that city.
mechanics.notes: The instruction card says to put one of these on each Epidemic card. The scan is a single sticker. The sticker does not mention Plague cubes.

items.title: IT'S WEARING OFF
items.placementTarget: Instruction kept with the Epidemic stickers. A faint red 55 is printed at the right edge.
items.text:
IT'S WEARING OFF
Put these stickers on each Epidemic card
to replace step 2 "Infect."

mechanics.effect: Apply the step-2 stickers to each Epidemic card, replacing step 2 "Infect."

summary: Epidemic step-2 replacement titled "It's wearing off." Each Epidemic draws a random Infection card from Package 6, strips that city's Supply cubes, and discards the card.
